title: Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care Rate Card and Late Cancellation Terms, Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services
content:
Keystone Ridge charges the following private-pay rates for **Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services**. The rates are figures of the Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care; every other tier of the product carries a zero private-pay rate and a zero late cancellation fee.

## Rates by tier

| Tier | Evaluation fee | Re-evaluation fee | Charge per timed treatment unit | Charge per group therapy session | Notice to cancel a scheduled visit without a fee | Late cancellation or missed-visit fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care | $165.00 | $95.00 | $48.00 | $38.00 | 24 hours | $35.00 |
| Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 24 hours | $0.00 |
| Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 24 hours | $0.00 |
| Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 24 hours | $0.00 |
| Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 24 hours | $0.00 |
| Medical Assistance Therapy Plan of Care | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 24 hours | $0.00 |

## Terms

- **Evaluation and re-evaluation.** A private-pay evaluation is charged $165.00; a private-pay re-evaluation is charged $95.00.
- **Treatment units.** Timed treatment is charged $48.00 for each timed treatment unit billed.
- **Group therapy.** A group therapy session is charged $38.00 per session.
- **Cancelling a scheduled visit.** A scheduled private-pay visit may be cancelled without a fee with 24 hours' notice. A visit cancelled late, or missed, carries a fee of $35.00.

## Worked figures (hypothetical visits)

| Hypothetical item | Charge |
|---|---|
| A treatment visit billed at 3 timed units | 3 units multiplied by $48.00, which is $144.00 |
| A treatment visit billed at 2 timed units | 2 units multiplied by $48.00, which is $96.00 |
| One group therapy session | $38.00 |
| A re-evaluation | $95.00 |
| A visit cancelled with 31 hours' notice | No fee: the notice is at least 24 hours |
| A visit cancelled with 9 hours' notice | $35.00 |
| A scheduled visit missed without notice | $35.00 |
